issues: Violates mustNotDo by repeatedly calling the two abstract-level model publications (PMID 41602009, 41146378) full text, despite the brief requiring abstract-level recording until full text is preserved.
Internal contradictions in search and screening counts: 24 vs 16 searches, 116 vs 128 identified, 96 vs 118 vs 86 deduplicated, and inconsistent literature/guideline subtotals.
The delivery mixes conflicting audit logs, revision notes, and a final gate status of partial/unaccepted while the main report presents conclusions as settled.
Adds 15 sources beyond the three supplied and claims full-text preservation for all without verifiable support, weakening provenance.
judge.rationale: The main report does answer the scoping question and lists the required independence elements. However, it breaches the abstract/full-text constraint, contains contradictory process counts and audit logs, and asserts full-text preservation for all sources without verifiable support. Claim bonding is asserted via IDs but is unreliable given these inconsistencies. Safety framing is appropriately non-clinical.
